bundle.shortDescription: A file manager where moving a file requires driving a tiny forklift
bundle.longDescription: PALLET moves regular files between folders inside one chosen warehouse folder. You drive a forklift to do it. Moves are journaled same-volume renames that never overwrite; there is no delete.
